Occurrences.Kwic: 筌蹄之表。上根雖然瞥地，亦要向者裏面蘊藉將來；中下宜在逗機，寧許向圈兒外顢頇說得。即文字而能離文字，少林亦所不呵；由多聞而後捨多聞，慶喜因斯結集。流通大教，必資瓶瀉之譚；演暢辯才，應徹貫花之旨。常山西高峰有藏經閣，某上人心希竺典、志慕高流，思坐閱以結長期、將校讎而探奧頤，既匪一朝卒業、聊程限于三年，況階眾友問津，宜裏糧于千日，是敢告於福田長者，并乞緣於慧業文人。趙州半轉，曾煩婆子施錢；秪樹全提，亦藉給孤布地。今古豈無嗣響？果因終不唐捐。慳囊打破，方知龍藏有珠；貝葉掀翻，謾道牛皮穿透。檀波願遂，般若功圓。化鐘疏化鐘疏敲鐘謝響，有人山下；回頭演唄，登樓問誰？床腳種菜，好是風晨；月夕吹到；耳邊帶累。露柱燈籠，打得心痛；機無小大，扣之則鳴。聲徹幽明，聞斯透脫；當機一擊，萬象知音。重建真歇了禪師塔院疏重建真歇了禪師塔院疏真歇了禪師，道契丹霞、脈傳洞山，荷如來之重擔、握法門之要樞。七坐名藍、五承紫詔，其出世一段光明、利生無邊作用，天童覺和尚銘其塔文，概述之矣！塔在皋亭山，宋孝宗敕建禪寺，名「顯孝」，諡曰「悟空」，真身藏石龕中，覆以甍棟。元阿朮曾發龕，見師端坐顏貌如生，十爪從兩袖出，繞腹三迴，阿朮驚異膜拜，親抱石揜之。自宋迄明，巋然無恙，即有頹弊

Occurrences.Kwic: 齋次，拈起餬餅問僧：「江西湖南還有這箇麼？」曰：「適來喫箇甚麼？」公曰：「敲鐘謝響。」著語云：收鞭太速。拈曰：這僧俊鶻沖霄到也快便，怎奈末上遭他網子？秪如道：「敲鐘謝響又作麼生？」對他合云：「草賊大敗。」
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (J/J27/J27nB198.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Xueguan, Yingshan Zhiyin naming himself Xueguan in the same old-case series. Yingshan Zhiyin owns the picking deployment: entering the case of Chen Cao the Minister — at the shared meal picking up the glutinous cake and asking whether Jiangxi and Hunan have this, the monk asking what the Minister just ate, the Minister answering strike the bell, thank the echo — his interlinear note whips in the rein too fast, and his pick grants the monk a fine hawk dashing to the heavens yet caught in the net at the last move, then asks how to answer the strike-the-bell line itself and supplies his own: the grass bandits are routed.

Occurrences.Kwic: 舉：「陳操尚書因同僧齋次，拈起胡餅問云：『江西、湖南還有者個麼？』云：『尚書適來喫個甚麼？』公云：『敲鐘謝響。』」師云：「行腳衲僧者般說話好。云：『行者取一碗水來與尚書漱口。』縱伊食飽弄筋，要且驚雷失箸。」
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (J/J39/J39nB463.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Gumei Dinglie of Weishan, the whisk-holding series at the Imperial Seal cloister. Gumei Dinglie owns the differing deployment: raising the case of Chen Cao the Minister at the shared meal — picking up the wheat cake and asking whether Jiangxi and Hunan have this, the monk asking what the Minister just ate, and the Minister answering strike the bell, thank the echo — Gumei grants this the sort of talk walking monks do well in, then differs: send for a bowl of water for the Minister to rinse his mouth, for let him eat his fill and play his sinews, the startling thunder still makes him drop his chopsticks.

Senses.Explanation: A criticism of answering or crediting the resulting sound while overlooking the strike and bell that produced it. Yingshan Zhiyin appraises the Chen Cao exchange with the bell-and-echo criticism. Gumei Dinglie independently uses the image to judge another bell case.
